scenes.headline: IS UPI REALLY 100% FREE?!
scenes.voice: Aapko lagta hai UPI 100 percent free hai? Toh payment apps ka convenience fee check karo!

scenes.headline: ₹2 TO ₹5 PLATFORM FEES
scenes.voice: Recharge, electricity bill aur movie tickets par apps 2 se 5 rupaye platform fee lene lage hain!

scenes.headline: 1.1% WALLET INTERCHANGE
scenes.voice: Aur 2000 rupaye se upar ke wallet payments par merchants par 1.1 percent MDR lagta hai!

scenes.headline: 14 BILLION TRANSACTIONS/MONTH
scenes.voice: Har mahine 14 billion transactions handle karne ka server cost nikalne ke liye yeh fees add ho rahi hain!

scenes.headline: ZERO FEE BILL PAYMENT HACK
scenes.voice: Hack simple hai: Utility bills hamesha direct bank app ya government portal se pay karo, zero surcharge!
